info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Internal Network Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Internal Network Operation Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of internal network functions within an organization. It allows consumers, such as IT managers and network administrators, to monitor and retrieve current status information of various network operations. This API supports troubleshooting and performance tracking, ensuring optimal network functionality. Typical use cases include automated alerts for network anomalies and regular status reports for compliance and operational reviews.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of internal network operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of ongoing internal network operations, providing insights into their performance and availability. Utilize this operation for monitoring and troubleshooting purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of the internal network operation. This body contains the necessary parameters to query the current status of the operation.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status has been retrieved.

ListInternalNetworkOperationStatusReques.description: This schema represents the status of internal network operations in the IT management system.

ListInternalNetworkOperationStatusRespon.title: Internal Network Operation Status Response

environment.description: The environment in which the operation is occurring (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: The identifier for the change associated with the operation.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for managing the operation.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for the operation.

serviceTier.description: The service tier for the operation (e.g., basic, premium).

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target availability percentage for the service.

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled maintenance window for the operation.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the status record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the status was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the operation.

ListInternalNetworkOperationStatusRespon.description: This schema represents the response structure for retrieving the status of internal network operations.
